transcription_verified.residual_risk: Pages not read back rely on the text layer alone. The source is born-digital, not a scan, so extraction is character-exact; the read-back exists to catch dropped marks and reading-order faults, not OCR error. A solving session must re-read its own paper in full before an answer is authored against it.
